## Does the set information help? Training on the sets against training on one level of each set

Task code + driver code. Test NLL (against the uniform-over-set label) over all test answers, over single-level answers only, and over set answers only, at the checkpoint selected on validation NLL; mean over drivers. `lower` is the hard-label loss of the main runs (CORN (hard), CE (hard)); `upper` and `random` train the same loss on the upper median or a random member of every set. The difference sets minus collapsed is paired over drivers (bootstrap 95% interval, paired t-test p, n = drivers in which training on the sets is better).
